name: Shodan InternetDB: alert on new open port or CVE

parameters.content:
## New port or CVE alert
The trigger polls InternetDB every 12 hours and emits one item per newly opened port or newly reported CVE on your IPs. The first activation only records a baseline and emits nothing.

Prefer WhatsApp? Replace the Telegram node with a WhatsApp node (for example WhatsApp Business Cloud, or an HTTP Request to GreenAPI) and reuse the same message expression.
